code_citations.why: resolve_tier maps a WRITE_CAPABLE_PRINCIPALS key to Tier.STANDARD_EMPLOYEE (returned at line 115); the tier is only an enum result
... but calls data_entitlement.tool_denial(tool) with NO tier argument: the tier never reaches the entitlement guard
run_integration_tool (the Schwab chokepoint) resolves the tier here ...
... and calls tool_denial(tool) with no tier argument; the tier is used only for audit and for guard.enforce_min_tier at line 163
Schwab spec min_tier is read_only, so the tier floor passes every tier and distinguishes none
current_access reads the principal's profile/grant from the store keyed tid/oid; the only input besides the store is the principal
decide: a principal with a profile is restricted; a restricted principal is served only a tool in its grant's allowed tools (line 378)
decide: with no profile a Schwab-class tool is denied (entitlement_denied) whatever the tier; no tier branch exists in the module
SchwabService._grant requires access.grant and the tool in access.tools, else ENTITLEMENT_DENIED; no tier input
schwab_query calls _scope(scope, {operation, master, dataset}) against the grant (de.check_scope)
check_scope refuses a master not in scope.masters (dimension masters), which surfaces as scope_denied:masters

note: At 4231bd2ddc the token WRITE_CAPABLE appears in app/ only in config.py, tier.py, token_broker.py, identity_scope.py and the ycharts integration (none in data_entitlement.py or app/integrations/schwab/), and the tier value (STANDARD_EMPLOYEE for a WRITE_CAPABLE_PRINCIPALS key) is never an input to data_entitlement.py or SchwabService: tools._run and base.run_integration_tool resolve it only for audit and min_tier (Schwab min_tier is read_only), then call tool_denial(tool) which decides from the principal's stored profile and grant alone. So a WRITE_CAPABLE principal is EVALUATED against its data grant. One probe on the real in-process gateway app of tests/acceptance (moto DynamoDB/S3/STS, synthetic random principal key on WRITE_CAPABLE_PRINCIPALS, resolve_tier read STANDARD_EMPLOYEE, audit tier recorded 'standard', AUDIT_PATH in tmp_path) granted master 08242234 only: schwab_query for 08242234 was SERVED (control), schwab_query for 08335338 was REFUSED with envelope code ENTITLEMENT_DENIED, reason scope_denied:masters; a WRITE_CAPABLE principal holding no profile at all was refused by the pre-dispatch guard (ENTITLEMENT_DENIED, entitlement_denied), so the tier opens nothing either way. Probe and its raw output: probes/test_g2_probe.py, probes/g2_probe_output.txt.
